facts.fact: The UMOA Banking Commission's 2025 report, as relayed by Horonya Finance, counts one licensed e-money issuer (EME) in Burkina Faso at end-2025, among 18 in the Union, and says Burkina Faso's EMEs hold 25.9% of e-money issued; the document gives no date for the licence, so the date is the end of 2025.
